descriptions.notStarted: I heard Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys has a new worry...
descriptions.inProgress: I met Mrs. Ming Ming again in Henesys who was preparing for the village festival. She said she needs food to prepare for the festival, and asked me to collect #b20 Pig's heads, 60 Octopus Legs, and Estelle's Special Sauce#k. To get the special sauce, I think I'll have to go find Estelle near Ellinia.
descriptions.completed: I met up with #bEstelle#k near Ellinia to get her #bSpecial Sauce#k, but she apparently she doesn't want to give it to me for free...
